requirements.quote: Offer one compliant base configuration. Identify the proposed processor and industrial-temperature components; equivalent architectures are acceptable where the stated results are demonstrated.
requirements.text: Provide a compliant base configuration with specified processor and components.

requirements.quote: No unpriced dependencies may be needed to achieve the requirements below.
requirements.text: Ensure no unpriced dependencies are required to meet the requirements.

requirements.quote: HW-01 Quad-core 64-bit processor, minimum 1.4 GHz; 2 GB RAM; 16 GB industrial eMMC. At least 4 GB shall remain available for application data after factory image installation.
requirements.text: Provide a quad-core processor, 2 GB RAM, 16 GB eMMC with 4 GB free after factory image.

requirements.quote: HW-02 18-36 VDC input; nominal 24 VDC. Power <=12 W at the Section 6.1 reference workload and <=2.5 W idle. Protect against reverse polarity and input overcurrent.
requirements.text: Support 18-36 VDC input, nominal 24 VDC, with power limits and protection features.

requirements.quote: HW-03 Two independent 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 Ethernet ports with unique MAC addresses, status LEDs and standard magnetics isolation.
requirements.text: Provide two Ethernet ports with unique MACs, LEDs, and isolation.

requirements.quote: HW-04 Two isolated, half-duplex RS-485 ports; 9.6-115.2 kbit/s; switchable 120-ohm termination and controlled biasing. Each field bus shall withstand 1.5 kVAC to logic for 60 s.
requirements.text: Provide two isolated RS-485 ports with specified features and withstand voltage.

requirements.quote: HW-05 One USB 2.0 service port; power, status and fault indicators; recessed recovery control. Disable interactive service access in normal production operation.
requirements.text: Provide a USB 2.0 port with indicators and recovery control, disabling interactive access in production.

requirements.quote: HW-06 Hardware watchdog, secure element or equivalent protected key store, secure boot and signed A/B software update. Device identity shall be unique and export-resistant.
requirements.text: Include hardware watchdog, secure element, secure boot, and unique device identity.

requirements.quote: HW-07 Cold boot to application-ready state <=60 s at 24 VDC. Recover to the last valid image after interruption at any update stage, without operator intervention.
requirements.text: Ensure cold boot readiness within 60 seconds and recovery without intervention.

requirements.quote: HW-08 24/7 operation for a five-year design life; retain configuration after unplanned power loss. Provide component derating and calculated MTBF >=100,000 h at 40 C.
requirements.text: Support 24/7 operation for five years, retain configuration, and meet MTBF requirements.

requirements.quote: At G0 provide a connector table defining pin, signal, voltage, isolation group and mating part.
requirements.text: Provide a connector table with detailed specifications.

requirements.quote: Supply removable 3.5 mm or 5.08 mm pitch terminal connectors rated for the selected design, with retention and polarity marking.
requirements.text: Provide removable terminal connectors with retention and polarity marking.

requirements.quote: RS-485 field ports shall expose A, B and signal reference; document shield/earth termination separately.
requirements.text: Expose RS-485 field ports and document shield/earth termination.

requirements.quote: The gateway shall operate from a separately supplied, current-limited SELV source. State startup inrush and the recommended source rating in the installation guide.
requirements.text: Operate from a SELV source and specify startup inrush and source rating.

requirements.quote: USB accessories shall not be necessary for normal operation.
requirements.text: Ensure USB accessories are not required for normal operation.

requirements.quote: All proposed connector and component substitutions are subject to buyer approval.
requirements.text: Obtain buyer approval for connector and component substitutions.
